record.question: Lewis Hamilton who has clinched a sixth Formula 1 world championship title at the US Grand Prix 2019 belongs to which of the following countries?
record.explanation: Answer D: UK. Hamilton is British (United Kingdom). Formula 1’s contemporary report calls him “the Briton” when reporting his sixth world title. Reference: https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/cloud-nine-doesnt-get-close-to-where-i-am-hamilton-on-title-number-6.5rlsqXFgIK8PkuasurjXb5. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
